title: Garnet Precision: the share is encrypted and the clock is running
debrief: Contain first and keep the evidence; restore from the offline tape, not by paying; report on time with what you know; tell customers whose drawings were taken plainly and early.

t1.title: 00:35 Saturday
t1.text: fs02 is still running and the attacker's VPN session is live.
t1.inject: The IT manager asks: shut fs02 down now, or pull its network cable?

choices.text: Pull the network cable, cut the VPN session, keep the machines powered on
choices.note: Stops the spread and keeps memory for forensics.
The encryption stops, but you lose what was in memory.

choices.text: Leave it running to watch the attacker
choices.note: Every minute more files are encrypted.

t1b.text: Another 600 files were encrypted while you watched.

choices.text: Isolate now and cut the VPN session

t2.text: The ransom note says 1.8 GB of drawings were copied and will be published in 72 hours.
t2.inject: The managing director asks whether to pay, because a big automotive customer's drawings are in the share.

choices.text: Don't pay; restore from the Thursday tape; get legal advice on the customer contracts
choices.note: Paying doesn't bring the copied drawings back and marks you as a payer.

choices.text: Pay quickly to stop the leak
choices.note: There's no way to make sure a copy is deleted.

t3.text: You noticed the incident at 00:31 UTC.
t3.inject: Legal asks when CERT-In must be told.

choices.text: File with CERT-In by 06:31 UTC with what we know, and update later
choices.note: Six hours from noticing, partial facts are fine.

choices.text: Wait until the investigation is finished

t4.text: Restore from tape can start now. The VPN still lets anyone in with a password.

choices.text: Turn on MFA for every VPN account and reset s.kale and adm.rjoshi before bringing fs02 back
choices.note: Close the door before you rebuild the room.

choices.text: Restore first, fix the VPN next week
choices.note: The same door is still open.

t5.text: Staff arrive. Customers are asking why the supplier portal is down.

choices.text: Tell staff and the affected customer plainly what happened and what you are doing

choices.note: It will come out, and then nobody believes you.
